describe.chat: Stage changes to how the deck’s words are spoken (the `terms:` front matter; it also absorbs `acronyms:` and `lexicon:`). Each `set` entry adds or replaces one term: `pronounce` is how the voice says it (empty string silences it), `expansion` what it stands for, `definition` a glossary line. One entry also covers the plural, possessive, hyphenated and title-case forms, so never add those separately. The slides keep the word as written. Call preview_speech first to hear how a line reads now.

pronounce.description: How to say it; "" silences the term; null clears it so the voice says the expansion.

summary.description: One or two sentences to the author: what you changed and why.
